QUOTE: Unless `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` is defined, `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`, so the struct field is renamed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the default rename to private_<member>, and that defining the opt-out leaves the plain name (`MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` becomes plain `x`).
